before.description: Root auth.js and .env had DIFFERENT secret values

after.description: src/middleware/auth.js reads from env with fallback. Single source of truth.

jwtFix.fixMethod: Consolidated to server/src/index.js which uses dotenv + src/middleware/auth.js which reads process.env.JWT_SECRET. Root auth.js is now unreachable (root index.js delegates to src/).

adminMerchantAuth.merchantMiddleware: merchantOnly() in src/middleware/auth.js — checks role==='merchant' (WAS MISSING in root-level)
adminMerchantAuth.staffMiddleware: staffOnly() in src/middleware/auth.js — allows admin OR merchant
